# Facebook
> Meta’s social networking platform for connecting with people, sharing content, and accessing help, privacy, and developer resources.

Facebook spans consumer help, privacy and policy information, business tools, and Meta’s developer platform for building integrations.

## Help Center
- [Help Center Home](https://www.facebook.com/help/): Central support hub for account, privacy, security, and product troubleshooting.
- [Using Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/help/104002523024878): Help articles about profiles, friends, posts, pages, and core features.
- [Managing Your Account](https://www.facebook.com/help/131719720300233): Guidance for login, password, account settings, and account recovery.
- [Privacy, Safety and Security](https://www.facebook.com/help/325807937506242): Resources for privacy controls, safety tools, and account protection.
- [Policies and Reporting](https://www.facebook.com/help/181495968648557): Information on reporting abuse, enforcement, and policy-related support.
- [Accessibility](https://www.facebook.com/help/273947702950567): Accessibility features and support information for using Facebook products.

## Privacy and Legal
- [Privacy Center](https://www.facebook.com/privacy/center/): Overview of privacy controls, data practices, and privacy education resources.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.facebook.com/privacy/policy/): Details on what information Meta collects and how it is used.
- [Terms of Service](https://www.facebook.com/legal/terms): Core terms governing use of Facebook services.
- [Cookies Policy](https://www.facebook.com/policies/cookies/): Explanation of how cookies and related technologies are used.
- [Community Standards](https://transparency.fb.com/policies/community-standards/): Rules defining what content is allowed on Facebook.
- [Transparency Center](https://transparency.fb.com/): Central resource for policies, enforcement reporting, and platform integrity information.

## Security
- [Security Features and Tips](https://www.facebook.com/help/security): Security guidance for protecting accounts and recognizing suspicious activity.
- [Hacked and Fake Accounts](https://www.facebook.com/help/1216349518398524): Recovery and reporting options for compromised or impersonating accounts.
- [Login Alerts and Two-Factor Authentication](https://www.facebook.com/help/148233965247823): Setup information for stronger login protection and alerts.
- [Privacy Checkup](https://www.facebook.com/privacy/checkup/): Guided review of privacy settings and audience controls.
- [Ad Preferences](https://www.facebook.com/adpreferences/): Controls for ad topics, advertisers, and personalization settings.

## Developers
- [Meta for Developers](https://developers.facebook.com/): Main developer portal for Meta platforms, tools, and documentation.
- [Documentation](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/): Entry point for platform docs, products, and implementation guides.
- [Graph API](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/graph-api/): Reference and guides for Meta’s core social graph API.
- [Marketing API](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/marketing-apis/): Documentation for ads management, insights, and campaign automation.
- [Facebook Login](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/facebook-login/): Authentication flows and integration guidance for Facebook sign-in.
- [Sharing](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/sharing/): Tools and documentation for sharing content from apps and websites.
- [Webhooks](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/graph-api/webhooks/): Event subscription documentation for receiving platform updates.
- [App Development](https://developers.facebook.com/apps/): Dashboard for creating, configuring, and managing developer applications.

## Developer Guides and Reference
- [Graph API Reference](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/graph-api/reference/): Object and edge reference for available Graph API endpoints.
- [Access Tokens](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/facebook-login/guides/access-tokens/): Guide to token types, usage, and lifecycle management.
- [App Review](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/app-review/): Requirements and process for requesting advanced permissions and features.
- [Permissions Reference](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/permissions/reference): Reference for Facebook permissions and approval requirements.
- [SDK Downloads](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/): Documentation hub covering available SDKs and platform libraries.
- [Platform Changelog](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/graph-api/changelog/): Version changes, deprecations, and updates across Graph API releases.

## Business and Advertising
- [Meta Business Help Center](https://www.facebook.com/business/help): Support for Pages, ads, commerce, and business account management.
- [Meta for Business](https://www.facebook.com/business/): Overview of business tools for marketing, messaging, and commerce.
- [Ads Guide](https://www.facebook.com/business/ads-guide): Ad format reference with objectives, placements, and creative specifications.
- [Create Ads](https://www.facebook.com/business/tools/ads-manager): Access point for managing campaigns in Ads Manager.
- [Meta Pixel](https://www.facebook.com/business/help/952192354843755): Setup guidance for tracking conversions and website activity.
- [Commerce Manager Help](https://www.facebook.com/business/help/389645202397258): Support for shops, catalogs, and commerce-related workflows.

## Creators and Pages
- [Pages Help](https://www.facebook.com/help/1629740080681586): Guidance for creating, managing, and troubleshooting Facebook Pages.
- [Creator Resources](https://www.facebook.com/creators/): Resources for creators building audiences and publishing content on Meta apps.
- [Professional Dashboard Help](https://www.facebook.com/help/715770466775983): Support for professional mode tools, insights, and monetization features.
- [Live Producer Help](https://www.facebook.com/help/publisher/167523253398500): Documentation for live streaming setup and publishing workflows.
- [Reels Help](https://www.facebook.com/help/527340041568165): Help information for creating and managing Facebook Reels.

## Newsroom and Engineering
- [Meta Newsroom](https://about.fb.com/news/): Official announcements, product updates, and company news from Meta.
- [Meta Engineering](https://engineering.fb.com/): Technical articles on infrastructure, AI, systems, and engineering practices.
- [Open Source](https://opensource.fb.com/): Meta’s open source projects, tools, and community initiatives.
- [Research](https://research.facebook.com/): Research publications and projects across AI, systems, and social technologies.

## Accessibility and Community
- [Accessibility on Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/help/273947702950567): Accessibility support and product features for diverse user needs.
- [Community Standards Overview](https://transparency.fb.com/policies/community-standards/): Summary of content rules and enforcement principles across Facebook.
- [Report Something](https://www.facebook.com/help/263149623790594): Instructions for reporting content, accounts, and safety concerns.
- [Voting Information Center](https://www.facebook.com/votinginformationcenter/): Civic information hub for elections and voting-related resources.
